settings.tagline: The GraphQL-first headless CMS in a single Rust binary
settings.description: Tess is a self-hostable, GraphQL-first headless CMS written in Rust. Define content models at runtime, publish with review workflows, and run it on Docker, a VM or AWS Lambda.
settings.footerText: © 2026 Tess Dev Team. Community edition for personal use, Enterprise edition for commercial use.

data.title: Tess vs Payload
data.description: Tess compared with Payload (Code-first headless CMS (TypeScript, Next.js)): An open-source TypeScript CMS configured in code, which installs inside a Next.js application.

competitor.chooseThem: - Your project is a Next.js app and you want the schema in your repository as TypeScript.
competitor.chooseTess:
- Admins must evolve models without developers or redeploys.
- Your front ends are not all JavaScript, or you want the CMS separate from the app.
competitor.migration: Payload collections and blocks map to Tess content types and components (blocks fields become `DYNAMIC_ZONE`). Translate the config into the `tess-transfer` YAML format, import it, and copy documents through the GraphQL APIs.
